description: Processors that Russet adds to the AutoPkg processor set. Each entry has the same shape as reference.json, and ordering has the same shape as cli-processor-order.json.

RussetURLDownloader.description: Downloads a URL to the specified download_dir with Russet's native HTTP engine, splitting a large download into parallel range requests when the server allows it. It never runs curl; a request the engine can't reproduce exactly fails.

CHECK_FILESIZE_ONLY.description: If True, a server's ETag and Last-Modified headers will not be checked to verify whether a download is newer than a cached item, and only Content-Length (filesize) will be used. This is useful for cases where a download always redirects to different mirrors, which could cause items to be needlessly re-downloaded. Defaults to False.

COMPUTE_HASHES.description: Determine whether to compute md5, sha1, and sha256 hashes of the downloaded file.

DOWNLOAD_MISSING_FILE.description: If the file is missing but matching metadata is present, download the file again. Defaults to True as most current recipes expect the files to be present. This re-fetch does not mark the item as changed (download_changed stays false); download_changed reflects the remote resource only. Omit the key to use the default; a blank string disables it. Note that a recipe Input of null resolves to a blank string during variable substitution, and so disables it.

HEADERS_TO_TEST.description: List of HTTP headers compared against the previous download to detect changes. Setting this replaces the default list for comparison purposes; if 'CHECK_FILESIZE_ONLY' is enabled, only Content-Length is compared. The default headers are always recorded in .info.json regardless, so narrowing this list does not discard cached metadata.

PKG.description: Local path to the pkg/dmg we'd otherwise download. If provided, the download is skipped and we just use this package or disk image.

curl_opts.description: Optional array of curl options to include with the download request. RussetURLDownloader accepts only the options its native engine reproduces exactly, and fails on any other.

download_dir.description: The directory where the file will be downloaded to. Defaults to RECIPE_CACHE_DIR/downloads.

filename.description: Filename to override the URL's tail.

prefetch_filename.description:
If True, URLDownloader attempts to determine filename from HTTP headers downloaded before the file itself. 'prefetch_filename' overrides 'filename' option. Filename is determined from the first available source of information in this order:
	1. Content-Disposition header
	2. Location header
	3. 'filename' option (if set)
	4. last part of 'url'.  
'prefetch_filename' is useful for URLs with redirects.

request_headers.description: Optional dictionary of headers to include with the download request.

download_changed.description: Boolean indicating if the download has changed since the last time it was downloaded.

download_info.description: Info from previous or current download.

download_url.description: The final URL the file was downloaded from (after redirects).

etag.description: etag header for the downloaded item.

file_md5.description: MD5 hash of the downloaded file.

file_sha1.description: SHA-1 hash of the downloaded file.

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the downloaded file.

file_size.description: Size of the downloaded file in bytes.

last_modified.description: last-modified header for the downloaded item.
